profiles.name: Adele Beacham
profiles.description: Sr. Adele Beacham SP, 76, has been a Sister of Providence for 56 years. Retired at St. Mary of the Woods. Volunteer ministries: Health Care, Secretarial work at our Tutorial House for children and adults, distributing food at a distribution center to families below the national income level. Committee work: I am a member of the Sisters of Providence Liturgy Committee, I am a member of the Day Care Board serving the educational needs of infants and pre-school children. I am also an active member of a Pax Christi Group. Prison ministry - Rockville Correctional Facility - Women's Prison. Sentenced on 1/28/03 to 12 months in home confinement, 250 hours community service. This custody record is documented by the SOA Watch Austin prisoner chronology: https://www.soaw-austin.org/POC1983_2012.php

profiles.name: Sami al-Hajj
profiles.description: Sami al-Hajj is a Sudanese-born Al Jazeera cameraman who was arrested by Pakistani authorities on December 15, 2001, while travelling to report in Afghanistan. Amnesty International records his transfer to U.S. custody on January 7, 2002, followed by detention at Bagram, Kandahar and, from June 13, 2002, Guantanamo Bay. He was held without charge and alleged torture and ill-treatment. His employer records his release from U.S. custody on May 1, 2008; he was repatriated to Sudan and taken to hospital on arrival.
